- **Decisions:** D-081
- **References:** 09 §5.9; 04c §11.1–11.5; 06 §4.12 API-M14-04…12; 16 TS-VEN-02, TS-FE-04; BP §11.2, §11.3; A20; T12, T13
- **Description:** Implement vendor product submissions (09 §5.9; BP §11.2 Products, §7.3, §11.3, §17.4): own approved listings with pending-change and suspension state and listing detail with live version, pending diff and history (API-M14-04, API-M14-05); new-product and change submissions entered through the schema of a permitted category (API-M14-12; 403 CATEGORY_NOT_PERMITTED), saved as drafts visible only to the own organisation, edited with `expected_version` and moved by validate, submit, withdraw, duplicate and delete (API-M14-06…API-M14-10), with field issues, history and the reviewer conversation (API-M14-08, API-M14-11). Validation A20 (BR-M14-12, BR-M04-11) runs before review: required attributes, types and units, contradictory condition labels, image availability and quality with rights confirmation, duplicate barcodes, impossible dimensions, missing tax classification, unapproved brands or categories, mandatory warranty provider (BP §29.3), grade from the approved rubric (D-023) and inspection and data-erasure evidence for refurbished units; submit is allowed only without blocking errors, locks editing and creates the `vendor_content` review item, sensitive fields (brand, condition, warranty, tax classification, extraordinary price change) are flagged (BR-M04-08, BR-M14-05) for routing to the designated reviewer, REQUIRES_DECISION (D-081), and the vendor identity comes only from the session. Submissions never publish: each creates or updates an E-catalog_change_version with source `vendor_submission`, so a new product stays non-purchasable until approved (BR-M04-06; T12) and a change to an approved listing stays pending while the last approved version remains live (BR-M04-07; T13); supplier price changes are cost signals only (BR-M05-14), declared quantities never become company stock (BR-M06-15) and suspended vendors are refused with 403 VENDOR_SUSPENDED (BR-M14-04). Not part of this task: staff review and publication (T-1B.1-M14-07), P-V02 #bulk (T-1B.2-M14-02), availability updates after approval (T-1B.2-M14-01), vendor messages without an open submission (API-M14-60, T-1B.1-M14-12) and activation of the A20 automation record with its BP §12.3 template (T-1B.4-M17-02).
- **Files/components:** `backend/vendors/` — VendorSubmissionService with A20 validation and endpoints API-M14-04…API-M14-12 (finer structure per D-001/D-002); `backend/catalog/` — change-version and draft handling through the ProductDraftService and LifecycleService interfaces (no direct table writes); `backend/pricing/` — cost-signal intake for supplier price changes; `backend/support/` — submission conversation with the vendor as counterparty; `frontend/vendor-portal/` — P-V02 header, #listings, d-listing, #submissions, d-sub, #new, m-submitted (finer structure per D-101); `tests/acceptance/` (TS-VEN-02 vendor part, T12, T13).
- **Database impact:** No schema change. Writes E-vendor_submission (types `new_product`, `product_change`; states draft, submitted, withdrawn and resubmission after `needs_changes`; validation_results, sensitive_flags, rights_confirmation), E-catalog_change_version (source `vendor_submission`, source_ref, base_version_no, change_set, sensitive_fields, validation_results), E-approval_request (`vendor_content`) on submit, E-attachment and E-media_asset for photos, E-cost_signal for supplier price changes, E-support_conversation and E-support_message for replies, E-audit_event; reads E-offer, E-sku, E-product, E-supplier_code_mapping, E-category_attribute, E-attribute_definition, E-condition_grade, E-warranty_policy and the active E-vendor_approval (permitted scope).
- **API impact:** Implements API-M14-04, API-M14-05, API-M14-06 (VEN; INT only with a catalog-scope credential if one is issued under D-083), API-M14-07 (including `format=csv` export of own submissions), API-M14-08, API-M14-09, API-M14-10, API-M14-11, API-M14-12. Consumes API-M22-01, API-M22-03 (photos) and API-M14-34 through the "Request a category" link to P-V04 m-req.
- **Frontend impact:** P-V02 per 04c §11.1–§11.5: header ("Templates" from API-M14-12, "Submit product"); #listings (info callout, search, category and grade selects, state segments, table, row actions) and d-listing (pending, suspended and live bodies, diff, version history, "Withdraw change", "Correct & resubmit", "Propose a change", "View on storefront"); #submissions (state segments with counts, search, table, empty state, "Export CSV") and d-sub (stepper; draft, submitted, needs-changes, approved and rejected bodies and footer actions); #new (category & identity, specifications from the schema, condition grade & warranty, images & content with rights confirmation, supplier price & availability; error summary with field links, submission checklist, "What happens next", Save draft / Validate / Submit for review) and m-submitted; non-permitted categories, grades and dispatch locations shown disabled; SLA, reply-by and threshold texts rendered from API values (D-185, D-186).
- **Backend impact:** M14 VendorSubmissionService (A20; BR-M14-04, BR-M14-05, BR-M14-06, BR-M14-10, BR-M14-12); M04 ProductDraftService, LifecycleService and PublicationChecker through service interfaces (BR-M04-04, BR-M04-05, BR-M04-06, BR-M04-07, BR-M04-08, BR-M04-11, BR-M04-12, BR-M04-13, BR-M04-14); M05 cost signals (BR-M05-14); M06 supplier quantity never company stock (BR-M06-15); M16 conversation with a vendor counterparty; M22 media handling (BR-M22-02); versioned save with `expected_version` (409 VERSION_CONFLICT) and state guards (409 STATE_TRANSITION_INVALID); every transition audited.
- **Testing requirements:** TS-VEN-02 vendor part (inline validation, draft → submitted, withdraw, needs changes → resubmit, non-purchasable until approved, sensitive edit keeps the live version); TS-UNIT-04 (vendor submission state machine); TS-UNIT-07 (validation rules including warranty provider and image rights); TS-API-04 (stale `expected_version`); TS-API-09 (BP §17.4 vendor-submission guards); TS-API-10 (client seller id ignored on API-M14-06); TS-PERM-02.4 (V1 reads or edits a V2 listing or submission → 404); TS-PERM-03.2 (protected approval fields rejected; T13); TS-PERM-12.1 (suspended vendor cannot submit); TS-SEC-03 (photo uploads); TS-FE-04 (P-V02 inline validation and states); TS-A11Y-02 (error summaries); T12 and T13 vendor part.
- **Acceptance criteria:**
   1. A draft is visible only to its own organisation; "Validate" returns errors and warnings mapped to fields; "Submit" succeeds only without blocking errors, locks editing and creates one review item; withdraw, duplicate and delete follow the state rules and return 409 STATE_TRANSITION_INVALID otherwise.
   2. A submission in a non-permitted category returns 403 CATEGORY_NOT_PERMITTED, a suspended vendor gets 403 VENDOR_SUSPENDED, a stale `expected_version` gets 409 VERSION_CONFLICT and a client-sent seller id has no effect.
   3. A refurbished laptop submission without a warranty provider fails validation with a clear field message (BP §29.3), and photos without the rights confirmation cannot be submitted.
   4. No vendor call publishes or makes a new product purchasable (T12); a warranty change to an approved listing creates a pending version while the approved version stays live and purchasable (T13); writes to protected fields are rejected.
   5. A supplier price change creates a cost signal and changes no retail or dealer price.
   6. Reviewer comments, field issues and the conversation are visible only on own submissions, and replies are stored against the submission.
   7. P-V02 #listings, d-listing, #submissions, d-sub, #new and m-submitted behave per 04c §11.1–§11.5, with keyboard-reachable error summaries.
   8. TASKS.md and STATE.md updated per the continuation protocol.
- **Evidence:** —

#### T-1B.1-M14-07 · Staff review of vendor submissions and review policy into catalog change versions; P-E11 #submissions (+ m-vsdec) and vendor items in P-E06 #review (API-M14-54, API-M14-56, API-M17-03)
- **Status:** REQUIRES_DECISION
- **Stage / Module:** 1B.1 / M14
- **Depends on:** T-1B.1-M14-06, T-1A.4-M04-09
- **Decisions:** D-081, D-185, D-186, D-004
- **References:** 09 §5.10; 04c §4.5; 04b §9.6; 06 API-M14-54, API-M14-56, API-M17-03; 16 TS-VEN-02, TS-PERM-14; BP §11.3; T12, T13
- **Description:** Implement the staff review of vendor submissions (09 §5.10; BP §11.3, §17.4, §18.1–§18.2): vendor items in the review queue (API-M04-39 `source=vendor`), the review view with diff against the live version, validation results, sensitive-field flags, vendor history and open-order impact (API-M14-54), and decisions through API-M17-03 (approve, reject, request changes with fields, approve and publish; `keep_live_version_until_resubmit`; `expected_version`) dispatched to M14 and M04 so that approvals advance the E-catalog_change_version and E-vendor_submission, publication still runs the publication checks and needs publish authority (05 §8 #3), publishing switches the live version atomically and invalidates search and caches (BR-M04-20), and rejected or returned changes leave the live version untouched. Guards: reviewer authority per change type, REQUIRES_DECISION (D-081) (403 AUTHORITY_EXCEEDED), approve refused while blocking validation errors exist, reason mandatory for reject, request changes and sensitive approvals (422 REASON_REQUIRED; the reason is sent to the vendor), reviewer different from the submitter where feasible (BR-M02-06), stale version → 409, bulk decisions keep per-item history (BR-M17-07) and tax-classification changes go to finance review where required (BP §18.1). The review policy (change type → handling → reviewer) is versioned configuration served by API-M14-56 (staff and vendor summary) and changed only through configuration change requests (API-M24-02), with reviewer roles REQUIRES_DECISION (D-081), bounds and the price-outlier rule REQUIRES_DECISION (D-186) and due times, pause while an item is with the vendor and escalation REQUIRES_DECISION (D-185) — none of them hard-coded (BR-M24-03). On approval the supplier code mapping and the initial supplier-held availability declared in the submission are recorded without creating company stock (BR-M06-15). Not part of this task: auto-accepted availability refreshes and their revert (API-M06-29, T-1B.2-M06-01), availability batches (T-1B.2-M14-01), the generic approval queue (T-1A.14-M17-06) and approval ageing or other approval-type extensions (T-1B.4-M17-01).
- **Files/components:** `backend/vendors/` — review view, `vendor_content` decision handler and review-policy reader (finer structure per D-001/D-002); `backend/catalog/` — vendor items in the review queue and publication through LifecycleService and PublicationChecker; `backend/admin/` — review-policy configuration key through the configuration service; `frontend/workspace/` — P-E11 #submissions with m-vsdec and vendor items in P-E06 #review; API-M14-56 also feeds the m-policy modal built by T-1B.1-M14-03 (only if D-004 decides "custom" for P-E11/P-E06; otherwise native configuration in `backend/` with the same guards); `tests/acceptance/` (TS-VEN-02 staff part, T12, T13).
- **Database impact:** No schema change. Updates E-vendor_submission (submitted → approved / published / needs_changes / rejected; reviewer_comment), E-catalog_change_version (reviewed_by/at, review_reason, requested_change_fields, approved / published / rejected), E-approval_request (`vendor_content` decisions with reason, delegation and bulk reference), E-offer, E-product and E-sku live versions on publication, E-supplier_code_mapping, E-supplier_availability (initial declaration, never company stock), E-configuration_version (vendor review policy), E-notification, E-audit_event (diff and reason).
- **API impact:** Implements API-M14-54 and API-M14-56. Extends API-M04-39 with vendor items and the `vendor_content` dispatch of API-M17-03 (contract 06 §4.13). Consumes API-M17-02, API-M17-04 (bulk decisions where available under D-192), API-M24-01 and API-M24-02 (review-policy configuration).
- **Frontend impact:** P-E11 #submissions per 04c §4.5: Needs review / All segments, split view, list items with number, age, vendor, type and status, detail header with Reject / Request changes / Approve ("Approve outlier" for held price lines, disabled while validation fails), variants for sensitive edit (pending-version callout, flags, check counts, diff grid), failed validation (error rows with field paths), supplier cost update with outlier lines held per D-186 and returned-to-vendor timeline with SLA pause per D-185; m-vsdec (decision, mandatory reason, "Keep the current live version until the vendor resubmits"). P-E06 #review vendor items per 04b §9.6: Vendor filter and badge, detail header from API-M14-54, live-version callout, diff, automated checks, decision note, Reject / Request changes / Approve / Approve & publish.
- **Backend impact:** M14 VendorSubmissionService review functions (BR-M14-05, BR-M14-12); M04 LifecycleService and PublicationChecker (BR-M04-05, BR-M04-06, BR-M04-07, BR-M04-08, BR-M04-09, BR-M04-20); M17 ApprovalService (BR-M02-06, BR-M17-06, BR-M17-07, BR-M17-13 recurring safe items flagged for policy review; decision and subject change in one transaction, TX-10); M24 versioned configuration (BR-M24-01, BR-M24-03); M20 notification of every decision to the vendor; M21 projection invalidation on publication.
- **Testing requirements:** TS-VEN-02 staff part (approve, request changes, reject; published only after approval; pending version never overwrites live); TS-PERM-14.1 (reviewer without the D-081 designation → 403 AUTHORITY_EXCEEDED); TS-PERM-08.1 (self-approval refused); TS-PERM-09.3 (stale approval → 409 VERSION_CONFLICT); TS-API-09 (BP §17.4 review-decision guards); TS-API-04; TS-UNIT-04 (change-version and submission transitions); TS-SVC-03 (decision audit with diff and reason); TS-SVC-09 (publication invalidates projections); TS-DB-03 (unapproved content never purchasable); TS-FE-03 (P-E11 #submissions and P-E06 #review if custom); T12 and T13 end to end together with T-1B.1-M14-06.
- **Acceptance criteria:**
   1. Every publication of vendor content has a decision by a reviewer authorised for that change type under D-081, with a reason where required, stored in the audit log with the diff and sent to the vendor.
   2. Approve is refused while blocking validation errors exist, a stale `expected_version` returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT and a submitter or requester cannot approve their own item.
   3. `approve_and_publish` still runs the publication checks; publication switches the live version atomically and invalidates search and storefront projections; before approval a new listing is not purchasable (T12) and a pending change never overwrites the live version (T13).
   4. Request changes returns the submission to the vendor with the fields and reason, and rejection leaves the live version unchanged.
   5. API-M14-56 returns the current versioned policy and P-E11 m-policy (frame built by T-1B.1-M14-03) displays it; reviewer roles, bounds, outlier rule and due times are read from configuration, not code.
   6. Bulk decisions keep each item's own decision and reason.
   7. P-E11 #submissions, m-vsdec and the P-E06 #review vendor items behave per 04c §4.5 and 04b §9.6.
   8. TASKS.md and STATE.md updated per the continuation protocol.
- **Evidence:** —

#### T-1B.1-M14-08 · Vendor suspension and reinstatement with effects on offers, availability, POs, tasks and submissions (API-M14-51)
- **Status:** REQUIRES_DECISION
- **Stage / Module:** 1B.1 / M14
- **Depends on:** T-1B.1-M14-04
- **Decisions:** D-189
- **References:** 09 §5.4; 06 API-M14-51; 16 TS-VEN-10, TS-PERM-12; BP §11.1
- **Description:** Implement vendor suspension and reinstatement (09 §5.4; BP §11.1): API-M14-51 `suspend`, by an authorised staff user with a mandatory reason, records an E-vendor_approval decision `suspended` that supersedes the active one, sets E-supplier.state to `suspended`, audits and notifies the vendor; `request_reinstatement` returns 202 APPROVAL_REQUIRED with an `account_reinstatement` approval request that the authorised approver (R-owner per 06 API-M14-51) decides through API-M17-03, after which a new decision `reinstated` supersedes the suspension. From the suspension onward the vendor scope evaluation refuses every live-change write — submissions, changes and availability updates — with 403 VENDOR_SUSPENDED (BR-M14-04; 07 §6.2 rule 8), permission caches are invalidated so this applies on the next request, and historical orders, POs, GRNs, returns and statements remain accessible to authorised staff. The effects on live offers, supplier availability, open POs, supplier-fulfilment tasks, pending submissions, supplier RMAs and vendor users' read access are REQUIRES_DECISION (D-189) and are implemented exactly as decided (the mockup's "live offers withdrawn, history visible" is a sample), and the vendor can never change its own state (BR-M14-10). Not part of this task: offer-level suspension for safety or quality, which is immediate and independent of vendor status (API-M04-20; BP §7.3), feed-level suspension (API-M06-27, T-1B.2-M06-01), consequences of expired documents (D-068) and the P-V01 suspended banner (T-1B.1-M14-12).
- **Files/components:** `backend/vendors/` — suspension and reinstatement in VendorAccountService and the D-189 effect handlers (finer structure per D-001/D-002); `backend/identity/` — suspended-state refusal in the vendor scope evaluation and cache invalidation; `backend/catalog/` — offer suspension through LifecycleService where D-189 requires it; `frontend/workspace/` — P-E11 d-vendor "Suspend…", "Request reinstatement" and suspended callout (only if D-004 decides "custom" for P-E11); `frontend/vendor-portal/` — suspended-state handling in the shell and P-V02 (V8); `tests/acceptance/` (TS-VEN-10).
- **Database impact:** No schema change. Writes E-vendor_approval (decisions `suspended`, `reinstated`; previous record superseded), E-supplier.state, E-approval_request (`account_reinstatement`), E-offer.lifecycle_state, E-supplier_availability, E-vendor_submission and E-vendor_user.state only as D-189 decides, E-notification, E-audit_event.
- **API impact:** Implements API-M14-51. Consumes API-M17-03 (reinstatement decision) and the M04 lifecycle operation behind API-M04-20 for offer suspension where D-189 requires it; the `suspended` state is exposed to the vendor through API-M14-02.
- **Frontend impact:** P-E11 d-vendor per 04c §4.3: "Suspend…" with mandatory reason, "Request reinstatement" showing "Sent for approval" with the approval reference (04c X5), suspended callout ("the vendor can't submit changes; POs, GRNs, returns and statements remain visible to authorised staff"). Vendor portal suspended state (04c V8): shell routes to the suspended notice, "Submit product" and change actions disabled, P-V02 suspended listings shown as not purchasable.
- **Backend impact:** M14 VendorAccountService status changes (BR-M14-04, BR-M14-10); M02 AccessPolicy scope evaluation including supplier state (BR-M02-02, BR-M02-14 cache invalidation); M17 ApprovalService (BR-M02-06 requester ≠ approver, BR-M17-06); M04 LifecycleService for offers per D-189; M20 notification of vendor admins; audit of suspend, request and decision with reasons.
- **Testing requirements:** TS-VEN-10 (live submissions blocked, D-189 effects, history accessible to staff); TS-PERM-12.1 (suspended vendor submits a change or updates availability → 403, history still readable by staff); TS-PERM-12 cache-invalidation case (state change effective on the next request, 07 §15 E11); TS-PERM-03 BOPLA case (vendor cannot clear its own suspension); TS-PERM-08.1 (requester cannot approve own reinstatement); TS-SVC-03 (audit with reason); TS-API-01; TS-FE-03 (P-E11 controls if custom); TS-FE-04 (vendor suspended state).
- **Acceptance criteria:**
   1. Suspension without a reason is rejected with 422 REASON_REQUIRED; with a reason it records `suspended`, sets the supplier state, audits and notifies the vendor.
   2. The next submission, change or availability write by any user of the suspended vendor returns 403 VENDOR_SUSPENDED and writes nothing.
   3. Authorised staff can still read the suspended vendor's orders, POs, GRNs, returns and statements.
   4. Offers, supplier availability, open POs, supplier-fulfilment tasks, pending submissions, supplier RMAs and vendor-user access behave exactly as recorded in D-189, with one automated test per effect.
   5. Reinstatement happens only through an approved `account_reinstatement` request decided by an authorised approver who is not the requester; the resulting `reinstated` decision supersedes the suspension and writes are accepted again.
   6. No vendor endpoint allows the vendor to change its own state.
   7. The P-E11 suspension controls and the vendor-portal suspended state behave per 04c §4.3 and §9.1 V8.
   8. TASKS.md and STATE.md updated per the continuation protocol.
- **Evidence:** —

#### T-1B.1-M14-09 · Supplier POs and returns to vendor in the portal: P-V03 #pos (+ d-po) and #returns (+ d-rtv) (API-M14-23, API-M14-24, API-M14-31, API-M14-32)
- **Status:** NOT_STARTED
- **Stage / Module:** 1B.1 / M14
- **Depends on:** T-1B.1-M14-04, T-1A.7-M07-04, T-1A.12-M13-06
- **Decisions:** —
- **References:** 09 §5.14, §5.16; 04c §12.2, §12.4; 06 API-M14-23, API-M14-24, API-M14-31, API-M14-32; 16 TS-VEN-06, TS-VEN-08
- **Description:** Build the vendor-side, read-mostly view of supplier purchase orders and returns to vendor (BP §11.2 Transactions "View purchase orders", Returns "Supplier RMA requests and evidence"): VendorPoService read endpoints API-M14-23 and API-M14-24 over the POs that purchasing created and sent in T-1A.7-M07-04 (only POs issued to the session's supplier from state `sent` onward — never draft, awaiting-approval or approved-but-unsent POs, BR-M07-10), and VendorRmaService endpoints API-M14-31 and API-M14-32 over the supplier RMAs raised by staff in T-1A.12-M13-06, with P-V03 #pos (+ d-po) and #returns (+ d-rtv). The vendor answers a `sent` RMA with a resolution (replacement, credit note, repair and return) or a dispute with counter-evidence, which goes to purchasing for a decision through M13 SupplierRmaService; supplier-return stock movements, credit notes and closure stay with staff (T-1A.12-M13-06). The vendor also sees receipt and QC results for its own POs (MK "Own POs, GRN results & supplier RMAs"). Not in this task: PO confirmation/rejection and ASN (MOCKUP-ONLY, T-1B.1-M14-10, D-131), P-V03 #feed (T-1B.2-M14-01) and #tasks (T-1B.4-M14-01), the vendor-context isolation framework (T-1B.1-M14-04), PO/RTV action items, messages and notifications (T-1B.1-M14-12). Rules: BR-M14-06 (own records only; no company selling prices, margins or other suppliers' costs), BR-M14-07 and BR-M13-15 (returns show unit, serial and evidence only — never customer identity), BR-M07-01 (a PO has no stock effect).
- **Files/components:** `backend/vendors/` (VendorPoService read path, VendorRmaService read and response path); `backend/returns/` (vendor-response hook in SupplierRmaService); `frontend/vendor-portal/` (P-V03 page frame with the #pos and #returns tabs, drawers d-po and d-rtv); unit/service tests next to the code and acceptance cases in `tests/acceptance/` (finer structure per D-001/D-003; vendor-portal framework D-101).
- **Database impact:** None new. Reads E-purchase_order, E-purchase_order_line, E-goods_receipt, E-goods_receipt_line (DB-G5), E-supplier_rma (DB-G8), E-serial_unit, E-inspection, E-attachment; the vendor response updates E-supplier_rma (state `sent` → `accepted` with resolution_type, or `disputed`; state set REQUIRES_DECISION (D-139)) and writes E-audit_event and an E-notification to purchasing.
- **API impact:** Implements API-M14-23 and API-M14-24 (`vendor.ops.read`, operations/admin vendor sub-roles; API-M14-24 returns an empty `asn[]` unless T-1B.1-M14-10 is enabled), API-M14-31 (`vendor.ops.read`; catalog/accounts view per D-137) and API-M14-32 (`vendor.rtv.respond`; body resolution, note, refs; `409` when the RMA is not awaiting a response). Consumes API-M22-02 (QC evidence files, owner-scoped), API-M02-01 (UI permission hints); the staff side API-M13-14, API-M13-15, API-M13-16 already exists (T-1A.12-M13-06).
- **Frontend impact:** P-V03 page frame (header "Availability & orders", tab bar; #feed and #tasks are added by their own tasks). P-V03 #pos: info callout (view wording; confirmation wording only with D-131), segmented Open / All / Closed → `status`, table PO · Issued · Lines · Value (the vendor's own supplier prices) · Deliver to · Expected / received · Status, row → d-po with header facts (PO number, issued, deliver-to, expected date), lines with ordered and received quantities, history and receipt/QC results — no decision, confirm, reject or ASN controls unless T-1B.1-M14-10 is enabled. P-V03 #returns: callout ("Customer identity is never shared — only the unit, serial and evidence"), segmented Open / All → `status`, table RTV · Source (inbound QC with GRN/PO reference, or warranty claim with customer RMA reference) · Unit (product, unit id, serial) · Issue & evidence · Requested · Due · Status, row → d-rtv (failure and quarantine callout, QC evidence via API-M22-02, resolution radios replacement / credit note / repair & return / dispute with evidence, "Note to Tradex", history, "Later", "Send response"). Out-of-scope ids show the generic not-found state (V2); controls follow vendor sub-role (V9, D-137); applicants see the tabs disabled (V7).
- **Backend impact:** M14 VendorPoService (read path) → M07 PurchaseOrderService: supplier derived from the session only (06 §1.4), company-only fields removed, per-line receipt and QC outcome included (BR-M07-04). M14 VendorRmaService → M13 SupplierRmaService: accepts a response only in state `sent`, stores resolution or dispute with note, references and attachments, routes disputes to purchasing (buyer responsibility per D-222) for a decision via API-M13-16, notifies staff through M20. Rules BR-M14-06, BR-M14-07, BR-M13-15, BR-M07-01, BR-M07-04. Every vendor response is audited with the vendor user and cross-vendor attempts are logged as security events (05 §5.14). The RTV response due time is read from configuration — value REQUIRES_DECISION (D-185).
- **Testing requirements:** TS-VEN-06 (view part: own POs only, no margins or company prices, receipt/QC results visible); TS-VEN-08 (vendor part: evidence shown, resolution options, dispute path to purchasing, no customer personal data; the staff part passed in T-1A.12-M13-06); TS-PERM-02.4 (V1 opens V2's PO or RTV by id via API-M14-24 or API-M14-32 → `404`, security event); TS-PERM-02.5 (V2's evidence file via API-M22-02 → `404`); TS-PERM-04.5 (applicant calling PO endpoints → `403`); TS-PERM-04.3 for API-M14-23 once vendor API credentials exist (T-1B.2-M14-01); TS-API-01 and TS-API-05 for the four endpoints; TS-FE-04 (P-V03 #pos and #returns states); TS-REG-02 for M14 and M13; T11 (PO and RTV part).
- **Acceptance criteria:**
   1. API-M14-23 returns only POs of the session's supplier in state `sent` or later; draft, awaiting-approval and approved-but-unsent POs of the same supplier are never returned; the `status` filter (open, closed, all) is applied after the supplier scope (TS-API-05).
   2. No field of API-M14-23 or API-M14-24 contains company retail or dealer prices, margins, company stock positions or other suppliers' costs; line values are the supplier's own PO unit costs (BR-M14-06, V3).
   3. API-M14-24 and API-M14-32 called with another vendor's id return `404 NOT_FOUND`, disclose nothing and log a security event (TS-PERM-02.4, T11).
   4. d-po shows ordered and received quantities, history and receipt/QC results; with D-131 not approved it offers no confirm, reject, save-draft or ASN control and API-M14-24 returns an empty `asn[]`.
   5. API-M14-31 items carry source, unit, serial, issue, evidence, requested resolution, due and status and contain no customer name, contact, address or order detail (BR-M13-15, V5).
   6. API-M14-32 accepts a response only while the RMA is `sent`, with resolution replacement, credit note, repair and return, or dispute; any other state returns `409`; the response and any dispute are visible to staff on P-E04 #supplier and audited with the vendor user.
   7. QC evidence files open only through API-M22-02 for the vendor's own RMAs (TS-PERM-02.5).
   8. Sub-role gating follows the D-137 configuration (operations/admin respond; catalog/accounts view returns only) and applicants receive `403` on the PO and RTV endpoints (TS-PERM-04.5).
   9. TS-VEN-06 (view part), TS-VEN-08, TS-PERM-02.4, TS-PERM-02.5, TS-FE-04 and TS-API-01 for API-M14-23, API-M14-24, API-M14-31, API-M14-32 pass.
   10. TASKS.md and STATE.md updated per the continuation protocol.
- **Evidence:** —

#### T-1B.1-M14-10 · Supplier PO confirmation and advance shipping notices with serials (MOCKUP-ONLY; E-advance_shipping_notice; API-M14-25, API-M14-26)
- **Status:** REQUIRES_DECISION
- **Stage / Module:** 1B.1 / M14
- **Depends on:** T-1B.1-M14-09
- **Decisions:** D-131
- **References:** 09 §5.14; 03 §2.21.24; 06 API-M14-25, API-M14-26; 04c §12.2 (m-reject, m-asn)
- **Description:** MOCKUP-ONLY feature (MK:vendor-availability.html#pos; BP §11.2 only says suppliers "View purchase orders"): built only if D-131 approves building PO confirmation and ASN; if D-131 chooses view-only, the task is recorded per D-213 and nothing is built. While not approved, API-M14-25 and API-M14-26 answer `FEATURE_DISABLED` and P-V03 hides the decision columns, "Save draft", "Send confirmation", "Reject whole PO" and "Send ASN" (12 §1.3, TS-ECOM-14). When approved: the vendor confirms, partially confirms or rejects each line of a `sent` PO with a ship-by date and a reason for every partial or rejected line before the confirmation deadline (value REQUIRES_DECISION (D-185)), or rejects the whole PO with a reason (reason list REQUIRES_DECISION (D-139)); unconfirmed quantity goes back to purchasing and unconfirmed POs are escalated to purchasing after the deadline (MK:vendor-dashboard.html). The vendor then sends an advance shipping notice (dispatch date, carrier, AWB/LR, boxes, vendor tax invoice number, e-way bill number where applicable per D-037, serials); this task migrates E-advance_shipping_notice (DB-G9, MOCKUP-ONLY) and fills the E-purchase_order.supplier_confirmation placeholder. An ASN never creates or receives stock: the GRN (T-1A.7-M07-05) still scans and validates every serial, and a declared serial that differs from the scanned unit creates a discrepancy (BR-M07-01, BR-M07-05, BR-M07-11, BP §9.4, T15); the PO read views stay in T-1B.1-M14-09.
- **Files/components:** `backend/vendors/` (VendorPoService response and ASN paths), `backend/purchasing/` (VendorPoService bridge: supplier confirmation on the PO, ASN link at goods receipt), E-advance_shipping_notice migration in `backend/`; `frontend/vendor-portal/` (P-V03 d-po decision columns, m-reject, m-asn); `frontend/workspace/` P-E09 confirmation state and timeline only if D-004 decided custom for P-E09 (else native configuration in `backend/`); tests next to the code and in `tests/acceptance/` (finer structure per D-001/D-003; vendor-portal framework D-101).
- **Database impact:** Creates E-advance_shipping_notice (DB-G9 conditional part: unique (supplier_id, asn_number), index (purchase_order_id), asn_number format per D-123, declared_serials unique within the ASN and untrusted until the GRN scan, state submitted / in_transit / received / cancelled, goods_receipt_id linked at receipt). Writes E-purchase_order.supplier_confirmation (DB-G5 placeholder; content per D-131: line decisions, confirmed quantities, ship-by dates, reasons, responder, time); E-notification to purchasing; E-audit_event.
- **API impact:** Implements API-M14-25 (`vendor.po.respond`, Idem, actions confirm / reject / save_draft, `lines[{line_id, decision, confirm_qty, ship_by, reason?}]`, `reject_reason`; `409` per contract) and API-M14-26 (`vendor.po.respond`, Idem, `201 {asn_id}`); extends API-M14-23 statuses (awaiting confirmation, confirmed, partially confirmed, rejected) and API-M14-24 `asn[]`. Both new endpoints answer `FEATURE_DISABLED` while D-131 is view-only. Consumes API-M07-05 (staff PO detail shows the supplier response) and the unchanged goods-receipt endpoints API-M07-09 and API-M07-13.
- **Frontend impact:** P-V03 #pos: confirmation callout, status values Awaiting confirmation / Confirmed / Partially confirmed / Rejected by you, deadline column confirm-by / ship-by, row actions "Review" and "Send ASN". d-po: lines columns "Your decision & reason" (Confirm / Partially confirm / Reject + reason), "Confirm qty" (0…ordered), "Your ship-by"; error callout "Give a reason for every partially confirmed or rejected line"; info callout on unconfirmed quantity; footer "Reject whole PO", "Save draft", "Send confirmation". m-reject: reason select (samples, D-139) + details, warning that rejections count toward fill rate (metric per D-187). m-asn: dispatch date (warn if after ship-by), carrier, AWB / LR number, boxes (≥ 1), tax invoice no., e-way bill no. (conditional, D-037), serial numbers one per line (required for serialised SKUs; count = units shipped; unique). Staff: P-E09 #orders status "Sent · awaiting confirmation" and d-po confirmation timeline with linked ASN (04c §2.3, §2.10; screens of T-1A.7-M07-08).
- **Backend impact:** M14 VendorPoService → M07 (BR-M07-01, BR-M07-03, BR-M07-05): validates a reason for every partial/rejected line, confirm_qty within 0…ordered, ASN serials unique and equal in count to the shipped units of serialised SKUs (05 §5.14 validation); one idempotency key per user intent (X7, D-079); confirmation-deadline reminder and escalation to purchasing via outbox and M20 (deadline D-185); unconfirmed quantity flagged to purchasing for re-sourcing; the MK rule "confirmed quantities are deducted from declared availability" applies only once supplier availability exists (T-1B.2-M06-01, T-1B.2-M14-01, stage 1B.2); the GRN of T-1A.7-M07-05 links the ASN and still validates serials; every response and ASN audited with the vendor user.
- **Testing requirements:** TS-VEN-06 (confirmation and ASN cases); TS-ECOM-14 (disabled state: `FEATURE_DISABLED`, hidden controls); TS-API-01 and TS-API-03 (idempotent replay of API-M14-25 and API-M14-26); TS-API-04 (stale version → `409`); TS-PERM-02.4 (V1 responds to or sends an ASN for V2's PO → `404`); TS-PERM-04.5 (applicant → `403`); TS-DB-01 (E-advance_shipping_notice migration apply and rollback); TS-FE-04 (d-po, m-reject, m-asn states); T15 (serial on the ASN differs from the scanned unit → discrepancy at GRN, never sellable); TS-REG-02 for M14 and M07.
- **Acceptance criteria:**
   1. D-131 is DECIDED; if view-only, the task is recorded per D-213, API-M14-25 and API-M14-26 return `FEATURE_DISABLED` and P-V03 shows no decision or ASN control (TS-ECOM-14).
   2. If approved: "Send confirmation" is rejected until every partially confirmed or rejected line has a reason, confirm_qty outside 0…ordered is rejected, and replaying a request with the same idempotency key has no second effect.
   3. "Reject whole PO" requires a reason; after a confirmation or rejection, P-E09 shows the supplier response and timeline and the unconfirmed quantity is visible to purchasing.
   4. A PO still unconfirmed at the configured deadline raises one reminder/escalation to purchasing; the deadline value comes from configuration (D-185), never a constant.
   5. API-M14-26 creates one E-advance_shipping_notice per accepted request; duplicate serials within an ASN, or a serial count different from the shipped units of a serialised SKU, are rejected with a field error.
   6. An ASN creates no stock movement; the GRN still requires serial scanning and a scanned serial that differs from the ASN creates a discrepancy, never sellable stock (T15, BR-M07-05).
   7. API-M14-25 or API-M14-26 with another vendor's PO id returns `404` (TS-PERM-02.4).
   8. TS-VEN-06 (confirmation/ASN cases), TS-API-03, TS-DB-01 for E-advance_shipping_notice and TS-FE-04 pass.
   9. TASKS.md and STATE.md updated per the continuation protocol.
- **Evidence:** —

#### T-1B.1-M14-11 · Vendor statements with statement queries; P-V04 #statements (API-M14-39, API-M14-40)
- **Status:** REQUIRES_DECISION
- **Stage / Module:** 1B.1 / M14
- **Depends on:** T-1B.1-M14-04, T-1A.15-M19-01
- **Decisions:** D-011
- **References:** 09 §5.17; 04c §13.4; 06 API-M14-39, API-M14-40; BP §11.2
- **Description:** Supplier statement for the vendor's own account, built only if accounting data is integrated per D-011 (BP §11.2 Finance "Relevant supplier statements if integrated"; BR-M14-14). API-M14-39 returns a read-only projection of invoices (supplier bills), payments, debit notes/TDS and running balance for a period, with summary tiles (balance payable, next payment run, amounts on hold with reasons, last payment) and PDF/CSV output; API-M14-40 turns a query on a statement line into a support ticket answered by finance (response time REQUIRES_DECISION (D-074)). The projection is computed by M19 StatementService (BR-M19-02) from E-supplier_bill/E-supplier_bill_line (matched to PO and GRN by T-1A.7-M07-07, BR-M07-06) and the accounting authority's payment and deduction data received through the accounting adapter of T-1A.15-M19-01; no statement entity is stored, and company selling prices and margins never appear (BP §3.1; MK "never part of your statement"). When D-011 means statements are not integrated, API-M14-39 and API-M14-40 answer `404 FEATURE_DISABLED`, P-V04 hides #statements (or shows "Statements are not available") and the header "Download statement" is hidden. Not in this task: the P-V04 page frame and its other tabs (T-1B.1-M14-04, T-1B.1-M14-05), the accounting export itself (T-1A.15-M19-01) and finance's ticket screen P-E05 #tickets (T-1A.13-M16-04).
- **Files/components:** `backend/finance/` (StatementService projection and PDF/CSV rendering), `backend/vendors/` (read-scope wrapper for API-M14-39 and API-M14-40), `backend/support/` (ticket creation reuse); `frontend/vendor-portal/` (P-V04 #statements, header "Download statement"); tests next to the code and in `tests/acceptance/` (finer structure per D-001/D-003; vendor-portal framework D-101).
- **Database impact:** None new. Read-only projection over E-supplier_bill, E-supplier_bill_line (DB-G5) and E-accounting_export (DB-G8) plus accounting-authority payment/deduction data (availability per D-011); a query creates E-support_ticket (DB-G10) with the statement document in linked_records. E-support_ticket (03 §2.14.3) has no supplier reference and no category for statement queries — a supplier link and a category value are needed before build.
- **API impact:** Implements API-M14-39 (`vendor.finance.read`, accounts/admin vendor sub-roles; query period, type_filter, format json/pdf/csv; `summary{balance_payable, next_payment_run, on_hold, last_payment}`; `404 FEATURE_DISABLED` when not integrated) and API-M14-40 (body document_ref, message → `201 {query_id}`; `FEATURE_DISABLED` when not integrated). Uses M19 StatementService and M16 TicketService internally; no staff endpoint added.
- **Frontend impact:** P-V04 #statements: title "Supplier statement · <period>" with source and freshness note ("synced <time>", X11), period select, "PDF" and "CSV", KPI tiles from `summary{}`, type segmented All / Invoices / Payments / Debit notes & TDS, note "Invoices are matched to PO + GRN before they become payable", table Date · Document · Reference (PO · GRN, UTR, RTV) · Payable to you · Paid / deducted · Balance · Status · "Query" (message form → API-M14-40), footer "Tradex's selling prices and margins are never part of your statement"; amounts labelled incl. GST and taken from the API only (X3); not-integrated state hidden or notice. P-V04 header "Download statement" (`format=pdf`, accounts/admin only).
- **Backend impact:** M19 StatementService (BR-M19-02) with an M14 read-scope wrapper (BR-M14-06, BR-M14-14): supplier from the session only, never a parameter; PDF/CSV rendered server-side with CSV formula-injection neutralisation (BR-M18-05); freshness of the last accounting sync returned with the statement (BR-M18-03); a query becomes an M16 TicketService ticket for R-finance carrying the document reference; statement views, downloads and queries are audited (MK "Every view and export is logged"). How the finance answer is shown back in the portal is not defined in 06-api.md (no vendor read of query status).
- **Testing requirements:** TS-PERM-02.4 (V1 cannot obtain V2's statement; statement part of T11); TS-ECOM-14 (not-integrated state: `404 FEATURE_DISABLED`, tab and button hidden); TS-SEC-10 (formula cells neutralised in the statement CSV); TS-API-01 for API-M14-39 and API-M14-40; TS-FE-04 (P-V04 #statements states); reconciliation case: statement totals for a sample period reconcile with the supplier bills and the accounting authority's supplier ledger (BP §14.2; T27 scope, TS-ERP-14 data); TS-REG-02 for M14 and M19.
- **Acceptance criteria:**
   1. D-011 is DECIDED; if statements are not integrated, API-M14-39 and API-M14-40 return `404 FEATURE_DISABLED` and P-V04 shows neither the #statements content nor "Download statement".
   2. If integrated, the statement of a sample period reconciles line by line and in total with the supplier bills and the accounting authority's supplier ledger for that supplier (BP §14.2).
   3. No output of API-M14-39 (json, pdf or csv) contains company selling prices, margins or another supplier's data; amounts come from the API and are labelled incl. GST.
   4. The endpoints accept no supplier identifier; V1 can never obtain V2's statement lines or documents (TS-PERM-02.4).
   5. Only the accounts/admin sub-roles of the D-137 configuration can call the endpoints; other vendor roles and applicants receive `403`.
   6. CSV output neutralises formula cells (TS-SEC-10) and PDF/CSV files are generated server-side.
   7. The statement shows the time of the last accounting sync.
   8. "Query" creates one support ticket with the document reference for finance, returns `query_id` and the ticket is visible to finance in P-E05 #tickets.
   9. TS-PERM-02.4 (statement case), TS-ECOM-14, TS-SEC-10, TS-API-01 and TS-FE-04 pass.
   10. TASKS.md and STATE.md updated per the continuation protocol.
- **Evidence:** —

#### T-1B.1-M14-12 · Vendor dashboard, action items and two-way messaging; P-V01 (API-M14-03, API-M14-53, API-M14-60, API-M20-01)
- **Status:** NOT_STARTED
- **Stage / Module:** 1B.1 / M14
- **Depends on:** T-1B.1-M14-06, T-1A.13-M20-03
- **Decisions:** D-004
- **References:** 09 §5.18, §5.20; 04c §10; 06 API-M14-03, API-M14-53, API-M20-01; 16 TS-FE-04
- **Description:** Build P-V01 and its data endpoint API-M14-03 (dashboard aggregation in M14 VendorPerformanceService), two-way vendor↔staff messaging and the vendor bell (BP §11.2; PR1 §3 "Vendor registration, dashboard …"; MK R05 "Vendor KPIs — own records only", R10 "Action items replace calls & emails"). P-V01 gets the greeting with "data as of", the account-state card for approved / applicant / suspended (API-M14-02, approval record from API-M14-33, applicant detail from API-M14-67), KPI tiles (live listings, in review, needs changes, open POs), "Needs your action" (Open / Done this week, sorted by due time, each item linking to an own record the user's sub-role may act on), "Recent submissions", "Coming up" and the static "What you can see" panel; all content is computed from the vendor's own records and the never-shown list (company selling prices, margins, costs, other vendors, company stock positions, full customer data) is enforced by the server (BR-M14-06, BR-M14-07). Messaging: staff message a vendor with API-M14-53 (P-E11 d-vendor "Message", P-E01 "Contact vendor") and vendors message vendor management with API-M14-60 (P-V02 d-listing "Contact reviewer" without an open submission, P-V03 PO and RTV drawers); both become M16 conversations with the vendor as counterparty that appear in the staff shared inbox P-E05 (T-1A.13-M16-04), with an in-app notification and an email copy per D-058; the vendor bell consumes API-M20-01 and API-M20-02 from T-1A.13-M20-03. Not in this task: the scorecard section and "Fill rate · 90 days" tile (T-1B.1-M14-13), announcements (T-1B.1-M14-14, D-142), PO-confirmation items (T-1B.1-M14-10, D-131), the availability-feed tile, freshness countdown and feed items (added by T-1B.2-M14-01 together with API-M14-18, stage 1B.2), pilot-task items (T-1B.4-M14-01, D-007), submission replies API-M14-11 (T-1B.1-M14-06) and the marketplace "Sell directly on Tradex" card (LATER, D-046).
- **Files/components:** `backend/vendors/` (dashboard aggregation for API-M14-03, messaging wrappers for API-M14-53 and API-M14-60, vendor notification events); `backend/support/` (vendor counterparty in ConversationService); `frontend/vendor-portal/` (P-V01 sections, vendor-shell bell dropdown wiring, message forms on P-V02 d-listing and P-V03 d-po and d-rtv); `frontend/workspace/` (P-E11 d-vendor "Message" and P-E01 "Contact vendor" controls, only where D-004 decided custom for those screens, else native configuration in `backend/`); tests next to the code and in `tests/acceptance/` (finer structure per D-001/D-003; vendor-portal framework D-101).
- **Database impact:** None new. Reads E-vendor_submission, E-purchase_order, E-supplier_rma, E-vendor_approval, E-vendor_application, E-verification_document (document-expiry items) and, from stage 1B.2, E-supplier_availability; writes E-support_conversation (counterparty_type `vendor`, supplier_id required) and E-support_message (DB-G10), E-notification (channel `in_app`, DB-G7) and E-audit_event. E-support_conversation.channel has no value for portal messages and E-support_message.sender_type has no vendor sender (03 §2.14.1, §2.14.2) — both values are needed before build.
- **API impact:** Implements API-M14-03 (`vendor.self.read`; kpis[], actions[{type, ref, due}], actions_done_this_week[], recent_submissions[], upcoming[]; R-vendor_applicant receives its own application state only; scorecard{} is added by T-1B.1-M14-13 and announcements[] by T-1B.1-M14-14), API-M14-53 (`vendor.admin.message`: R-catalog_staff, R-ops_admin; body text, related_ref) and API-M14-60 (`vendor.self.read`; related_ref must be the vendor's own listing, PO or supplier RMA; `201 {conversation_id}`). Consumes API-M20-01 and API-M20-02 (T-1A.13-M20-03), API-M14-02, API-M14-33, API-M14-67, API-M14-07, and the staff inbox API-M16-04…API-M16-07 (T-1A.13-M16-02). A vendor-side operation to list and read message threads that are not tied to a submission is not defined in 06-api.md and is needed for the vendor to read staff messages in the portal.
- **Frontend impact:** P-V01: header (greeting, date, vendor name and id, "data as of"; actions "Purchase orders" → P-V03 #pos, "Bulk upload" → P-V02 #bulk, "Update availability" → P-V03 #feed, each hidden per sub-role (V9) and until its target exists); account-state card variants (approved with permitted categories, approval date/approver, terms version, dispatch location; applicant with review status and awaiting items — review due value D-185; suspended with date, reason and reinstatement path — effects D-189); KPI tiles (definitions D-173); "Needs your action" item cards (due badge, title, detail, action button to the record) with empty state "Nothing needs your action"; "Recent submissions" table with "All submissions →"; "Coming up" dated list; "What you can see" panel (static, BP §3.1, §11.2). Applicant: state card and profile links only (V7). Vendor shell: bell dropdown with "Mark all read" and links to records (refresh per D-146). Message forms on P-V02 d-listing ("Contact reviewer") and P-V03 d-po / d-rtv; staff "Message" on P-E11 d-vendor and "Contact vendor" on P-E01 (D-004).

#### T-1B.1-M14-13 · Vendor performance metrics and scorecard: P-E11 #performance and P-V01 scorecard (API-M14-55)
- **Status:** REQUIRES_DECISION
- **Stage / Module:** 1B.1 / M14
- **Depends on:** T-1B.1-M14-12
- **Decisions:** D-187, D-004, D-075
- **References:** 09 §5.19; 04c §4.7, §10.4; 06 API-M14-55; 16 TS-VEN-11; BP §11.2, §14.3
- **Description:** Vendor performance (BP §11.2 Performance "Data quality and response time"; BP §14.3 "Freshness, fill rate, dispatch, returns → Adjust vendor permissions/priority"; R06): M14 VendorPerformanceService computes per-vendor metrics — fill rate, response time, dispatch SLA (supplier-fulfilment pilot only, D-007), return/defect rate, first-pass approval of submissions and feed on time — from POs and receipts (reusing the M07 supplier metrics of BR-M07-13), submissions, supplier RMAs, pilot tasks and supplier availability; staff read them with API-M14-55 on P-E11 #performance and each vendor sees only its own scorecard{} in API-M14-03 on the P-V01 "Performance scorecard" section and "Fill rate · 90 days" tile. Metric definitions and targets are approved under D-187 (mockup definitions and targets are samples); the composite score, its weights and any automatic consequence (permission review, auto-accept switch-off, PO priority, pilot eligibility) are MOCKUP-ONLY and built only if D-187 approves them, each consequence being an audited, reviewable action, and performance never changes prices (BR-M05-14). Each metric is shown with its data freshness (BR-M18-03) and uses consistent denominators with test transactions excluded (BR-M18-07); a metric whose source records do not exist yet (pilot dispatch without D-007, feeds before stage 1B.2, PO response without D-131) is shown as "Not rated", never as zero. P-E11 #performance is custom UI only if D-004 decides custom for P-E11 (else native configuration in `backend/`), and the vendor-performance report in P-E13 is added to the report catalogue only if it is in the launch report set (REQUIRES_DECISION (D-075)). Not in this task: the other P-V01 sections (T-1B.1-M14-12) and P-E11 #list / d-vendor (T-1B.1-M14-03), which only display the score and KPI values this service provides.

## Stage 1B.2 — Validated bulk import & supplier feeds

#### T-1B.2-M04-01 · Validated import pipeline A01: upload to staging, validation, mapping profiles, inline row fixes, retries, commit to drafts/change versions, error report, templates; P-E06 #import and m-import-new (API-M04-30…38; E-import_job, E-import_row, E-import_mapping_profile; S-21)
- **Status:** REQUIRES_DECISION
- **Stage / Module:** 1B.2 / M04
- **Depends on:** T-1A.4-M04-04, T-1A.4-M22-01, T-1A.1-M17-01, T-1A.3-M24-01, T-1B.2-M06-01
- **Decisions:** D-057, D-078, D-004
- **References:** 05 §5.4, §4 A01; 04b §9.5, §9.10; 06 API-M04-30…38; 03 §2.3.17, §2.3.18, §2.21.19, §6 S-21; 16 TS-ERP-15, TS-API-08; BP §7.4; R20; T26
- **Description:** Build the M04 CatalogImportService (A01) staged pipeline for staff catalog imports: a versioned CSV/XLSX file (template per job type from S-21) is uploaded to staging (E-import_job, E-import_row), every row is validated against the category template and the BP §7.4 checks (BR-M04-10, BR-M04-11), columns are mapped with saveable, versioned mapping profiles (E-import_mapping_profile), supplier codes get a per-job decision (create draft / map to existing SKU / ignore), a preview diff is shown, and commit turns only valid rows into drafts or E-catalog_change_version rows through ProductDraftService — nothing is published here (review and publication stay with T-1A.4-M04-05 and T-1A.4-M04-09; BR-M04-06). Row errors are fixed inline and only failed rows are retried; the job is keyed by file hash and rows by row hash so re-imports and retries never duplicate products, SKUs, drafts or images (T26; 03 §5.1 I-01); a row-level error report is downloadable, a job that exhausts its retries raises one incident (A38) and rows left rejected raise an import_rows_rejected exception. Not in this task: reusable cross-job supplier-code mappings and scheduled supplier feeds (T-1B.2-M04-02), media fetch and the invalid-image queue (T-1B.2-M22-01), writing supplier quantities to E-supplier_availability (the M06 write path of T-1B.2-M06-01), vendor batches (T-1B.2-M14-02), migration imports (T-1A.4-M25-01). Stage placement follows D-048/D-078 (00 §12 #5: BP §5.1 puts validated bulk import in 1B while BP §12.2 marks A01 P1); supplier file formats are REQUIRES_DECISION (D-057); the A01 rule is registered with its BP §12.3 technical template fields (BR-M17-01); its S-17 record and activation belong to T-1B.4-M17-02 and happen only if D-078 selects A01 for the 1B set.
- **Files/components:** `backend/catalog/` (CatalogImportService: staging, row validators, column/profile mapping, per-job supplier-code decisions, preview diff, commit, error report; S-21 seed script), `backend/automation/` (A01 rule record in the automation registry of T-1A.14-M17-01), `frontend/workspace/` `screens/p-e06-catalog/` #import tab and m-import-new (only if D-004 = custom for P-E06; otherwise native configuration in `backend/`), `tests/acceptance/` (T26) (finer structure per D-001/D-101).
- **Database impact:** No migration — E-import_job, E-import_row, E-import_mapping_profile and E-supplier_code_mapping are DB-G2 entities already migrated by T-1A.4-M04-01 (E-import_mapping_profile is part of DB-G2 per 03 §4); writes E-import_job (source_type file_upload, job_type catalog, file_hash, template_version, mapping_profile_id, state, counts), E-import_row (raw/mapped values, match_result, result, messages, row_hash, retry_of_row_id), E-import_mapping_profile versions, E-catalog_change_version drafts, E-job_attempt, E-exception_case, E-attachment (import files, templates, error reports; private class), E-audit_event; loads seed S-21 (versioned templates per job type as E-attachment files and mapping profiles per supplier file) with decided values only (D-057).
- **API impact:** Implements API-M04-30…API-M04-38 (STF; keys `catalog.import.run` for API-M04-30, API-M04-33…API-M04-36 and `catalog.import.read` for API-M04-31, API-M04-32, API-M04-37, API-M04-38 per 07 §13.3; Idem on API-M04-30, API-M04-35, API-M04-36; `202` + import_job_id with status via API-M04-32 per 06 §1.12). Consumes API-M22-01 (import file upload, private class) and is reached from the shell "New › Bulk import" shortcut.

- **Testing requirements:** TS-ERP-15 (imports with mixed rows and no duplicates on repeat — T26 automated in `tests/acceptance/` and passing), TS-API-08 (`202` + job reference, status endpoint, expiring error-report download), TS-API-01 contract cases for API-M04-30…API-M04-38, TS-API-03 (replay and `409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` on API-M04-30, API-M04-35, API-M04-36), TS-UNIT-07 (a pass and a fail case for every BR-M04-11 import-row check), TS-SEC-03 (upload type/size limits), TS-SEC-10 (error report formula neutralisation), TS-ERR-06 (failing job → exactly one incident with owner), TS-FE-03 (#import and m-import-new states, if custom), TS-PERM-01 (new routes mapped to `catalog.import.*`), TS-DB-05 (S-21 loads decided values only), TS-REG-02 for M04. - **Acceptance criteria:**
   1. API-M04-30…API-M04-38 behave as specified in 06-api §3.3 (request, validation, response, errors) with the 07 §13.3 permission keys; TS-API-01 and TS-PERM-01 pass for them.
   2. Upload returns `202 {import_job_id}` and the job moves through uploaded → validating → validated → publishing → completed / completed_with_errors / failed; no product, SKU, offer, price or stock record changes before commit (BP §7.4).
   3. Each BP §7.4 check (required attributes, contradictory condition labels, image availability, duplicate barcodes, impossible dimensions, missing tax classification, unapproved brands/categories) produces a row message with field and code; TS-UNIT-07 cases pass.
   4. An unsupported or retired template version is rejected with a clear message; API-M04-37 serves the S-21 templates and mapping profiles, and saving a changed profile creates a new profile version.
   5. An inline fix (API-M04-34) re-validates only that row; "Retry failed rows" (API-M04-35) reprocesses failed rows only and records a new E-job_attempt; successful rows are not reprocessed.
   6. Commit (API-M04-36) turns only valid or acknowledged-warning rows into drafts / E-catalog_change_version rows awaiting review; error rows stay in staging; nothing becomes purchasable without review and publication.

#### T-1B.2-M22-01 · Media import A02: authorised media by product mapping, rights/type/size checks, invalid-image queue
- **Status:** REQUIRES_DECISION
- **Stage / Module:** 1B.2 / M22
- **Depends on:** T-1B.2-M04-01, T-1A.4-M22-02
- **Decisions:** D-057, D-078
- **References:** 05 §4 A02, §5.22; 16 TS-SVC-08, TS-SEC-04; BP §7.4, §21.2 (images)
- **Description:** Build the M22 MediaImportService (A02): import of authorised product images by product mapping, for image references in catalog import rows of the T-1B.2-M04-01 pipeline and for E-import_job job_type media (media template from S-21); each image is attached only to the product/SKU the row maps to, and is taken only from allowed sources — allow-listed HTTPS URLs through the SSRF-restricted fetcher of T-1A.4-M22-02, or uploaded image files named by product code as shown in MK:vendor-products.html#bulk (accepted formats per D-057/D-113). Every image passes rights confirmation, type, size and dimension checks (BR-M04-12, BR-M22-02, BR-M22-03, BR-M22-04); failures set E-media_asset.validation_state = invalid with a reason and go to the invalid-image queue without blocking the rest of the job; marketplace listings are never scraped (BP §7.4, R20). Image fetch runs after the import commit as durable background work (02 §5 "Publish import rows"), re-runs never duplicate media assets (T26), and optimised variants are generated only from authorised originals on approval/publication by the existing ImageVariantService (02 §15.2; D-113). Not in this task: single-URL import m-url and API-M22-04 (T-1A.4-M22-02, T-1A.4-M04-08), the import pipeline itself (T-1B.2-M04-01), media of single vendor submissions (T-1B.1-M14-06).
- **Files/components:** `backend/files/` (MediaImportService A02, invalid-image handling), `backend/catalog/` (media job type and image-column hand-off inside CatalogImportService), `tests/security/` (SSRF cases), `tests/acceptance/` (repeat media import) (finer structure per D-001).
- **Database impact:** No migration — writes E-media_asset (owner, source_type, source_reference, import_url, rights_confirmed, rights_confirmed_by / at, validation_state) and E-attachment originals in the private class (DB-G0/DB-G2, already migrated); uses E-import_job (job_type media) and E-import_row results, E-job_attempt, E-exception_case; media templates are part of seed S-21 (loaded by T-1B.2-M04-01).
- **API impact:** No new endpoint: media imports run through API-M04-30…API-M04-38 (job_type media; image rows and invalid-image reasons in API-M04-32, error report in API-M04-38); files arrive via API-M22-01; the fetch logic behind API-M22-04 (T-1A.4-M22-02) is reused. A list operation for the invalid-image queue across jobs has no API ID in 06-api (need reported).
- **Frontend impact:** No new screen: P-E06 #import (T-1B.2-M04-01) shows image rows, the image-fetch callout and invalid-image reasons in the row results; the product editor media panel (T-1A.4-M04-08) shows validation state. A dedicated invalid-image queue view has no mockup screen (placement D-004).
- **Backend impact:** M22 MediaImportService (A02) with M04 — BR-M04-11 (image availability), BR-M04-12, BR-M22-02, BR-M22-03, BR-M22-04, BR-M23-06; fetch only from allow-listed HTTPS hosts (list held in integration configuration, P-E15 #integrations), refusing private networks, localhost, cloud-metadata addresses and redirects to non-allow-listed hosts (02 §15.3); scanning of risky files per D-112; size/type/dimension limits from configuration (D-113, D-057); durable job with retries and cap → one failed_integration exception (A38; BR-M17-11); image-fetch jobs isolated from checkout (BR-M18-06); A02 BP §12.3 technical template fields recorded (BR-M17-01; S-17 record and activation by T-1B.4-M17-02 only if D-078 selects A02).
- **Testing requirements:** TS-SVC-08 (type/size limits, private vs public class, variants only from authorised originals), TS-SEC-04 (URL imports to internal, metadata or redirect targets rejected), TS-SEC-03 (upload restrictions and scanning per D-112), TS-ERP-15 (repeat media import creates no duplicate images — T26 image part), TS-ERR-06 (retry cap → one incident), TS-REG-02 for M22 (TS-SVC-08, TS-SEC-03, TS-SEC-04). Tests must prove that an image is never attached to an unmapped product and that a blocked URL is queued as invalid, not fetched.
- **Acceptance criteria:**
   1. Images in an import are attached only to the product/SKU mapped by their row; an unmapped or ambiguous reference becomes a row error, never a guess.
   2. Only allow-listed HTTPS hosts are fetched; private-network, localhost and cloud-metadata destinations and redirects to non-allow-listed hosts are refused and queued as invalid (TS-SEC-04 passes).
   3. Type, size and dimension limits are read from configuration with decided values (D-113, D-057) and enforced on every imported image.
   4. Every imported image records source_type and the rights-confirmation actor and time; an image without confirmed rights cannot pass the publication checks.
   5. Invalid images get validation_state = invalid with a reason visible in the job's row results, while valid rows of the same job still proceed.
   6. Re-running the same media import or retrying failed images creates no duplicate E-media_asset rows.
   7. Optimised variants are produced only after approval/publication and only from authorised originals.
   8. Media fetch runs as background work isolated from checkout, and after the retry cap exactly one failed_integration exception exists for the job.
   9. A02 is registered with its BP §12.3 technical fields complete; it stays off until T-1B.4-M17-02 activates it under D-078.
   10. TASKS.md and STATE.md updated per the continuation protocol.
